絶望の象徴が、目の前にいた。: The very embodiment of despair stood before him.
光の翼を持つ、あまりにも美しく、<br>そしてあまりにも冒涜的な、天使の姿をした:
It was a Calamity in the form of an angel, with wings of light—far too

こいつが、お前の言う『最高傑作』か？: So this is the 'masterpiece' you were talking about?
ああ。人の『嘆き』を喰らい、人の『祈り』を絶望へと変える、我が愛し子。<br>新:
Indeed. My beloved child—one who devours human lamentation and
turns human prayer into despair. A new Calamity: the Seraph of Lamentation.
そうだ。これは、今までの厄災のような、<br>力でねじ伏せる暴力装置ではない。:
Yes. Unlike the Calamities before it, this is no instrument of violence
meant to crush by brute force.
人の心に巣食う『悲しみ』に共鳴し、<br>それを増幅させ、所有者のいない『絶望』:
It resonates with the sorrow dwelling in human hearts, amplifies it,
and sublimates it into despair that belongs to no one.
そして、その絶望を糧に、無限に力を増していくのだ。<br>……この、私のように。:
And with that despair as its fuel, its power will grow without limit...
Just like me.
さあ、最初の『餌』は、どこだと思う？: Now then, where do you think the first meal is?
あの前線基地にいる、か弱き者たちの嘆きを喰らわせれば、<br>どのような美しい絶:
If I let it feast on the lamentation of the frail ones at the Frontline
Base... what a beautiful flower of despair would bloom!
